title: Lotus
tagline: Lotus: Igniting Decentralized Innovation. Where visionary ideas soar with expert evaluation, funding, and nurturing. Empowering creators to redefine progress in a collaborative ecosystem. Join us in crafting a future of limitless possibility.
description:
*Lotus: Fostering Innovation, Empowering Visions*

Step into a world where innovation knows no bounds, and visionary ideas are nurtured into reality. Welcome to Lotus Connect, a pioneering platform that goes beyond traditional grant structures, igniting the flames of creativity within the dynamic landscape of blockchain technology.

*A Nexus of Innovation:* Lotus is not merely a grant platform; it's a thriving ecosystem that serves as a nexus for creators, innovators, and blockchain enthusiasts. Our mission is to bridge the gap between visionary ideas and their tangible manifestation, providing a fertile ground for concepts to take root and flourish.

*Guided by Expertise:* We understand that the journey from idea to implementation is rife with challenges. That's why Lotus pairs your projects with seasoned project managers and developers. Their invaluable insights and experience lend direction to your idea, shaping it into a robust proposal that's primed for success.

*More Than Funding:* Lotus isn't solely about funding; it's about providing a holistic ecosystem of support. From expert guidance to technical assistance, we're here to ensure that your project thrives. Our mentorship-driven approach is designed to help you navigate obstacles, harness opportunities, and refine your vision.

*Catalysts of Collaboration:* Collaboration is at the heart of Lotus. By uniting creators, investors, and mentors under one roof, we cultivate an environment where diverse perspectives collide, leading to the generation of innovative solutions. Here, you're not just submitting a proposal; you're entering a community that's driven by a collective desire to push boundaries.

*The Promise of Lotus:* The name "Lotus" itself symbolizes purity, growth, and enlightenment. Just as the lotus flower rises from murky waters to bloom in pristine beauty, your idea will evolve and thrive under the nurturing guidance of Lotus. Together, we'll unlock new dimensions of blockchain innovation.

*Seize the Opportunity:* Embark on a transformative journey where innovation isn't just a concept – it's a reality waiting to be sculpted. Lotus beckons you to share your vision, embrace collaboration, and witness your ideas come to life within the ever-evolving landscape of blockchain technology.
how_its_made: This project used the popular Hardhat starter kit for smart contract deployment to multiple chains (Optimism mainnet and Base Testnet) while used foundry for (Zora Testnet and Mode Testnet) contract deployment, integrated  Amazon Web Service (AWS) backend storage to populate additional user's data to help remove extremely high cost of gas fees for storing user details on the Blockchain and also as an backup storage for the created proposals. For the frontend, react javascript library was used for a seemless working functionality of every connected blockchain/database functions, rainbowkit wallet integration was used for an easy wallet connecton experience and ethers.js library was used for the smart contract connection with the frontend.
